name: Input Chips Showcase

options.content:
**Top strip**: every type as a chip, wrapping — `Env · prod ⌄`, `Hosts · web-01 +2 ⌄`, `● Errors only`, `Severity · All ⌄` (radio), `Search · [ ] ×`, `Limit · [100]` (typed integer), `◷ Last 6 hours`, and **Notes** (multi-line → keeps label above, min width).

**Toolbar** (window toolbar): first three inputs are chips; the 4th sits in the toolbar's **Inputs** menu (legacy, unchanged).

**Sidebar**: Team / Mode keep the label-above look (unchanged).

Turn **auto-run off** to see the staged ● dot on chips until Run.

**Live token values** — change any chip and watch this update.

**Viz A** — this panel holds two vizzes, so its inputs sit in the **panel title band**, right of the title.

Narrow the window: chips collapse into **+N**; click it for the overflow row.
**Viz B** — band values: region `$band_region$`, split `$band_split$`, from `$band_time.earliest$`.

Single-viz panel: chips sit **in the viz's own title bar**, right of the title.

region `$wide_region$` · split `$wide_split$` · from `$wide_time.earliest$`

Hover the title bar: ⤢ maximise appears after the chips.

**2.4%**

Narrow single-viz panel with 5 inputs → most collapse into **+N**; the title keeps its room.

**Untitled single viz** — no title bar, so its chips stay in a **row above** the content.

pick `$untitled_pick$` · flag `$untitled_flag$`

Typed single-line chips: number, date, secure. The **Long** dropdown's value is 60+ characters — it ellipsises at 240pt, label stays whole.

num `$typed_num$` · date `$typed_date$`

options.content:
**5 · Time — viz overrides the dashboard.** This viz has its own time chip (`ov_t`, default Last 24 hours). The dashboard time is the top-strip **Time** (`t`). When they differ, the chip shows an amber **override** tag.

viz from `$ov_t.earliest$` · dashboard from `$t.earliest$`

Try the toolbar capsule `◷ │ ‹ │ › │ ⟳` (shift, ⌥ zoom, refresh → Live), the popover chips (Today = live "Today so far"), From/To `-1d@d` → `@d` = Yesterday, and Recent.
